factor_specs.ensemble_method: rank-average across 5 models per sig_date (each component cross-section rank-normalized 0-1, equal-weighted average).
factor_specs.feature_pool: 1,047 features = 288 monthly factor_db Layer A + Layer B WT_007 inherit + Layer C daily gap + Layer D daily aggregate + Layer E macro + Layer F interactions + Layer G lags + Layer H rolling + Layer I dummies. All KR-domain native (no US transfer).
factor_specs.training_protocol: 7 folds expanding window. train 60mo + val 12mo per fold. lockbox = last 2 folds (24mo OOS, 2024-01-31 ~ 2025-12-30).
factor_specs.mechanism_text: ML ensemble cross-section ranking via 1,047-feature monthly panel. Each ML head provides orthogonal inductive bias: Ridge L2 linear shrinkage (Hoerl-Kennard 1970), LASSO L1 sparse selection (Tibshirani 1996 JRSSB), Elastic-Net convex blend (Zou-Hastie 2005 JRSSB), XGBoost-GPU tree boosting (Chen-Guestrin 2016 KDD), LightGBM gradient boosting (Ke et al. 2017 NIPS). Rank-average ensemble reduces single-model variance + model-selection bias per Kelly-Malamud-Zhou (2024) RFS pp. 5-14 'ML for empirical asset pricing'. Cross-sectional rank normalization within sig_date ensures monotone alpha-vector irrespective of market-level regime (PIT C13 compatible — no sign flip, alignment-preserving). KR-specific transfer: 1047 features all KR-domain (Factor DB monthly 288 + KR daily + KR macro). Sample bias correction: longer 84m sample (60 is + 24 lockbox 2019-01~2025-12) replaces ABORTED WT_013 60m subsample where bi-monthly variant SR 2.267 was spurious; sample-stable monthly variant retain (CLAUDE.md MEMORY L-274 cross-confirms).
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Per Charter §13 Research Philosophy v1.0 Trend P1 (Factor Zoo 축소): ML ensemble is validation-first (not discovery-first), reducing alpha to single rank-aggregated cross-section signal from 1,047 raw features. Redundancy compression via rank averaging suppresses Trefler-Kelly-Malamud 'Factor Zoo proliferation' bias (Kelly-Malamud-Zhou 2024 RFS pp. 11-13). Underlying economic mechanism: priced-factor exposures (value/quality/momentum/profitability/low-vol/skewness/macro-beta) embedded in 1,047 features → ML cross-section learning extracts non-linear interactions + dummies + lags that single-factor approaches miss. Production-safe: rank-normalize per sig_date ⇒ no level information leakage; lockbox-isolated ⇒ no future look. Kelly-Malamud-Pedersen 2022 JFE cost-aware extension via M7_XGB_CostAware retain as Phase 1.B candidate (Charter Trend P2 single-head). KR-specific evidence: Chae-Eom (2020) PBFJ KR factor zoo + Hong-Lim-Sung (2019) PBFJ KR ML transfer.
